description: QEPANET creates and manages EPANET projects within QGIS, including topology-aware editing, terrain-derived elevations, pipe profiles and result maps. This resource is provided by aecforge (repository owner). Its method is not tied to one place; geographic inputs and simulation resolution depend on the user configuration. Access is through the linked repository or provider page; the exact file formats are not fully established. Licence: GPL-2.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: Version compatibility must be checked before reuse. The repository exposes a GPL-2.0 licence. The accessed repository shows no releases or reuse evidence beyond the small originating project. Its earlier duplicate mapping to the EPANET engine is too broad, but scope still depends on Q2. For simulation, it can support model preparation or execution. Related catalogue record: model-epanet. The relationship follows the named method or resource; it does not certify file compatibility.
